intent: style-transfer design boards for planning only

prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redesign the five approved monster identities in reference image 3 to match the ACTUAL GAME SPRITE STYLE in reference image 1 and tiny hero reference image 2. Image1 is the PRIMARY strict rendering and pixel-cluster reference; image2 is the protagonist style reference; image3 is identity/weapon/silhouette ONLY, not rendering. Current concept is much too detailed. Replace rendering completely with very simple flat chunky pixel sprites: thick dark midnight-navy silhouettes, huge connected cream-lit planes, flat amber-gold accent blocks, no gradients, no metal surface rendering, no rivets, no tiny highlights, no realistic anatomy, no noise. Use roughly 4 flat colors per character: #091a29 darkest, #e4a428 gold, #ffe0a1 cream, #9e7430 shadow. Pixel edges formed from deliberate large square clusters as if each individual creature occupies only a 48x64 or 64x80 logical pixel canvas enlarged by nearest neighbor; never use smooth vector curves. Keep faces almost blank dark voids with a single amber rectangular eye. Hooded/squat readable proportions like source1, NOT thin intricately jointed realistic armor. Aim for gameplay readability at the same scale as reference1. Deliver a landscape 1536x1024 DESIGN REVIEW BOARD, NOT a working atlas, with five equally spaced columns and two rows: idle above, simple big anticipation pose below. Opaque solid background #132638. All full bodies and weapon tips visible. Face left. Consistent scale between idle and anticipation. No scenery, no HUD, no fancy title lettering, only simple numbers above columns. Preserve the approved key motif of every individual and boss-versus-normal size hierarchy. Do not reproduce fine chains or small hanging decorations; collapse chains to thick stepped links. Do not add the protagonist as another column. Columns 1–5: 1 GATE SENTRY: empty simple hoodlike iron helmet, long spear and one small key silhouette. 2 BELL HOUND: short four-legged construct with hollow bell-clapper snout and short thick chain tail, low crouch. 3 CRACKED SWORD KNIGHT: compact empty armour, single strong crack, long clean sword upright then raised; no complex plates. 4 BARRICADE GOLEM: broad squat body made of simple detached crossbars, two chunky arms, one low sweep and one overhead; no complete city gate. 5 GATE GUARDIAN: largest, arched helm with ONE bell crest, tall barred shield and halberd; simplify shield to three broad bars and helm to a few big shapes. Only 1,2,3,4,5 labels. Strong distinction between broad low golem and tall guardian.
